title: Descant Recorder
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Sight reading from staff notation; the phone names the symbols in words.

skills.key_step: The child names what to check before playing from the staff: clef, key signature, time signature, note values, rests, tempo and dynamics.

floor.question: Which hand is on top of the recorder?

representations: a short piece on the board
steps: Look for rests, tempo and dynamics.
contexts: learning a piece for a concert

misconceptions.ask: What should you check before playing a melody?
misconceptions.repair: Read a piece from left to right: clef, key, time, then notes.
Clap a line and hold still at each rest.

misconceptions.ask: Which tells how fast to play?
misconceptions.repair: Sort words: allegro, andante (tempo); forte, piano (dynamics).

misconceptions.ask: A piece has one sharp at the start, on the F line. What do you play for every F?

checks.question: What does a rest tell you?
checks.answer: to be silent for its length

checks.question: Which tells how fast to play: tempo or dynamics?
